reddit.title: Improving Colony Music in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant enhancements to the music system in Provincia. No more abrupt transitions between day, night, and combat music! Our new long equal-power crossfade ensures a seamless listening experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Provincia Music System Update
steam.body: We're excited to share that we've improved the music transitions in Provincia! The day, night, and combat music now flow seamlessly into each other with our new crossfade feature. This enhancement ensures a more immersive experience as you build your colony. For more details, visit our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
